title: Ling 3.0 Flash VL gets video input
summary:
Video input arrived for Ling 3.0 Flash VL, model browsing got clearer, and seven models found new routes before Fireworks serverless shuts down.

A Quest contribution added the paid-only `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl` model with text, image and video input, tool calling, and a 131,072-token context. Video can be sent as a public HTTPS URL or base64 data URI in a `video_url` content part.

Enter’s model catalog now separates access, pricing options, extra fees and usage rates, with selectors for supported context, resolution, quality and other variants. Account and dashboard pages gained clearer key-permission summaries, steadier loading states and retry controls. The API docs also describe the response’s optional toolkit description field.

Team updates replaced Fireworks routes for seven models ahead of its September 25 serverless shutdown and added xAI direct as a third fallback for Grok 4.6. The model IDs stay the same. Image input now follows each model’s advertised limit rather than a fixed eight; Enter’s news card was corrected to describe the September 24 access and price changes without mixing in later scheduled changes.

highlights.title: Ling sees video
highlights.text: Send text, images and video to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl`, including video in a `video_url` content part. The paid-only model also supports tool calling. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl).

highlights.title: Explore model pricing options
highlights.text: Compare supported context, resolution, quality and other pricing options directly in Enter’s model catalog. The display is clearer; the rates and variant rules haven’t changed. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: More image inputs where supported
highlights.text: Image-URL conversion now uses each model’s advertised limit instead of stopping at eight images. That allows up to 30 for Kimi K2.6 and 20 for supported Bedrock models. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
